SELECT h.*
, (6371 * ACOS( LEAST(1, GREATEST(-1, COS(RADIANS(#{lat})) * COS(RADIANS(h.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(h.lng) - RADIANS(#{lng})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{lat})) * SIN(RADIANS(h.lat)) )) )) AS distance
FROM house h WHERE h.status = 1
AND (h.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY distance ASC
LIMIT #{limit}
